title: Who played in E-Van's band
summary: French lists E-Van's sidemen: his brother, Irvin and John Joseph, Walter and Fred Beats, and the interviewer places them today.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We've gotten out to Crowley and then you say you left E-Van, huh?
I worked with him and then I left.
I forgot to ask you who was in E-Van's band.
Well, he had his brother on drums, and Irvin Joseph, and John Joseph, a fella by the name of Walter. I forgot the fella named Fred Beats, it's been so long.
Irvin, you know Irvin, one-eye, one-eye, to play with pinch bass. You know, have one-eye. Joseph's drummer?
I play drums. Oh, him. And then you said John Joseph, what does he play?
Well, he plays bass now, the barber, at First and Liberty?
That's right. That's right. Yeah, I know him.
That's right. He moved from First and Liberty, now he's up on Washington. Let's see. Who else did you say was in the band besides those two? Walter something?
I don't know if and them, all I know is Evanne, but he had a brother, him Walter. He had some old fella, they had a plane beat, you know.
